# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.name: DESeq2 shrink and filter
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
infile <- args[1]
count_df <- read.csv(infile, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
stopifnot(ncol(count_df) >= 3)
stopifnot(count_df[[1]][1] != '')
gene_ids <- count_df[[1]]
count_mat <- as.matrix(count_df[, -1, drop=FALSE])
rownames(count_mat) <- gene_ids
storage.mode(count_mat) <- 'integer'
samples <- colnames(count_mat)
condition <- ifelse(grepl('^KL', samples), 'KL', ifelse(grepl('^WL', samples), 'WL', NA))
if (any(is.na(condition))) stop('Could not infer KL/WL condition from sample names')
coldata <- data.frame(row.names=samples, condition=factor(condition, levels=c('WL','KL')))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~ condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('condition','KL','WL'))
shr <- lfcShrink(dds, contrast=c('condition','KL','WL'), res=res, type='normal')
out <- as.data.frame(shr)
out <- cbind(GeneID=rownames(out), out)
write.table(out, file='deseq2_shrunken.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
keep <- !is.na(out$pvalue) & out$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(out$log2FoldChange) & abs(out$log2FoldChange) > 1 & !is.na(out$baseMean) & out$baseMean > 10
sig <- out$GeneID[keep]
writeLines(sig, con='sig_genes.txt')
summary <- data.frame(metric=c('total_genes','significant_genes','shrinkage_type','contrast'), value=c(nrow(out), length(sig), 'normal', 'KL_vs_WL'))
write.table(summary, file='deseq2_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript run_deseq2.R "$(inputs.count_csv.path)"

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(org.Mm.eg.db))

summary <- data.frame(metric=c('input_ensembl','mapped_rows','unique_symbols'), value=c(length(ids), nrow(map), length(symbols)))
write.table(summary, file='mapping_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT

set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
infile <- args[1]
count_df <- read.csv(infile, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
stopifnot(ncol(count_df) >= 3)
stopifnot(count_df[[1]][1] != '')
gene_ids <- count_df[[1]]
count_mat <- as.matrix(count_df[, -1, drop=FALSE])
rownames(count_mat) <- gene_ids
storage.mode(count_mat) <- 'integer'
samples <- colnames(count_mat)
condition <- ifelse(grepl('^KL', samples), 'KL', ifelse(grepl('^WL', samples), 'WL', NA))
if (any(is.na(condition))) stop('Could not infer KL/WL condition from sample names')
coldata <- data.frame(row.names=samples, condition=factor(condition, levels=c('WL','KL')))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~ condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('condition','KL','WL'))
shr <- lfcShrink(dds, contrast=c('condition','KL','WL'), res=res, type='normal')
out <- as.data.frame(shr)
out <- cbind(GeneID=rownames(out), out)
write.table(out, file='deseq2_shrunken.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
keep <- !is.na(out$pvalue) & out$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(out$log2FoldChange) & abs(out$log2FoldChange) > 1 & !is.na(out$baseMean) & out$baseMean > 10
sig <- out$GeneID[keep]
writeLines(sig, con='sig_genes.txt')
summary <- data.frame(metric=c('total_genes','significant_genes','shrinkage_type','contrast'), value=c(nrow(out), length(sig), 'normal', 'KL_vs_WL'))
write.table(summary, file='deseq2_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
